DHAKA, April 11, 2023 (BSS) - Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina today asked the authorities concerned to stress more on utilizing the untapped potentials of the 'Blue Economy'.

The Premier gave the directive while chairing a meeting on the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) held at the NEC Conference Room in the city's Sher-e-Bangla Nagar area here today. Ministers, State Ministers, Planning Commission members and secretaries concerned attended the meeting.
